title: 第二十章 青阳庄第二十五章 一探究竟
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
翌日清晨。
院落之中，方书文正在练功。
他的动作不快，一举一动都如同身负千钧之重。
一步跨出，破风之声宛如雷动。
一掌缓缓推出，带动的力道，让一旁的大树反复摇曳不休。
正在院子里喝茶的周青梅，却连落叶掉进了杯子都未曾察觉。
她神色略微恍惚，有些神思不属，不知道在想些什么，最后是被敲门的声音惊醒。
她看了方书文一眼之后，转身去开了门。
门外站着的是方家管事，还不等打招呼呢，就见到一个亭亭玉立的姑娘站在一旁。
这姑娘脸蛋圆圆，娇嫩可人，最引人瞩目的却是一双眼睛。
又大又圆，闪闪发光。
她眨着眼睛看着周青梅
“你就是周姐姐吧？听爹说，你救了我两次，上一次我醒来的时候，你已经走了。
“还好这一次你还在，可以当面感谢你的救命之恩。”
说完之后，似乎觉得有些唐突，又连忙补充了一句
“我叫方灵心。”
周青梅微微一笑
“灵心妹妹不必这般客气，都是因缘际会。
“而且昨天晚上可不仅仅只是我一个人救了你……”
“还有一位方大哥是吗？”

方灵心笑着说道
“正好一并感谢，我可以进去吗？”
“请。”
周青梅让开步子，方灵心跨入院中，不等开口，就见远处的方书文，忽然一掌探出。
庞大的力道如山呼海啸，虽然不是冲着自己，可其中所蕴含的威力，却被展现的淋漓尽致。
方灵心一瞬间瞪大了双眼
“好厉害！！”
周青梅闻言一笑
“方兄的武功，确实叫人叹服。”
不仅仅是武功高，资质悟性也非常人可比。
这短短的时日之中，他的【大黑天神掌】又有进境，渐有登堂入室之态。
着实叫人艳羡的很。
方书文就在此时，缓缓提掌收势，慢慢的吐出了一口浊气。
转回头，目光就落在了方灵心的身上
content_en:
The next morning.
In the courtyard, Fang Shuwen was practicing.
He didn't move quickly, and every move he made seemed like he was carrying a huge weight.
Taking one step forward, the sound of breaking wind was like thunder.
A palm was slowly pushed out, and the force caused the big tree on the side to sway repeatedly.
Zhou Qingmei, who was drinking tea in the yard, didn't even notice the fallen leaves falling into the cup.
She looked slightly dazed, a little lost in her thoughts, and didn't know what she was thinking. Finally, she was awakened by the sound of knocking on the door.
After she glanced at Fang Shuwen, she turned around and opened the door.
Standing outside the door was the steward of the Fang family. Before he could say hello, he saw a slim girl standing aside.
This girl's face is round, delicate and lovely, but the most eye-catching thing is her eyes.
Big, round, and shiny.
She blinked and looked at Zhou Qingmei
"Are you Sister Zhou? I heard from dad that you saved me twice. The last time I woke up, you were gone.
"Fortunately, you are still here this time, so I can thank you in person for your life-saving grace. "
After finishing speaking, he seemed to feel a little abrupt, so he quickly added:
"My name is Fang Lingxin. "
Zhou Qingmei smiled slightly
“Sister Lingxin, there’s no need to be so polite, it’s all by chance.
"And I wasn't the only one who saved you last night..."
"Is there another Brother Fang?"
Fang Lingxin said with a smile
"Thank you also. Can I come in?"
"Please."
Zhou Qingmei stepped aside and Fang Lingxin stepped into the courtyard. Before she could speak, she saw Fang Shuwen in the distance and suddenly thrust out a palm.
The huge force was like a mountain roaring and a tsunami. Although it was not directed at him, the power contained in it was vividly displayed.
Fang Lingxin's eyes widened for a moment.
"Awesome!!"
Zhou Qingmei smiled after hearing this
"Brother Fang's martial arts skills are truly impressive."
Not only is his martial arts high, his qualifications and understanding are also very comparable to others.
In this short period of time, his [Mahaykala Divine Palm] has made further progress, and has gradually entered the palace.
It's really enviable.
At this moment, Fang Shuwen slowly raised his palms to close his posture, and slowly let out a breath of turbid air.
Turning back, his eyes fell on Fang Lingxin
